name: Kingdom Of Marionettes
source:
You are a newly hired security guard assigned to watch over an abandoned puppet theater called Kingdom of Marionettes. 
Your duties are simple enough. keep troublemakers away, clean the theater, and make sure none of the puppets go missing or start wandering around. 
Wait. Wandering around? That has to be a joke.

Well... not exactly.

Because during your night shifts, the puppets are very much alive. And one of them, a mischievous jester puppet, seems eager to play with you.

[From [url=https://thepipiw.itch.io/kingdom-of-marionettes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名新聘的保安，被派去看守一个名为“木偶王国”的废弃木偶剧院。
你的职责很简单。赶走麻烦制造者，清理剧院，并确保木偶不会失踪或四处游荡。
等待。到处闲逛？这一定是个笑话。

嗯……不完全是。

因为在夜班期间，木偶非常活跃。其中一个是一个顽皮的小丑木偶，似乎很想和你一起玩。

[来自[url=https://thepipiw.itch.io/kingdom-of-marionettes]itch.io[/url]]
